eventDescription:
The Seeds Education Center has been working well at the Seeds Office for many years and has developed the intellectual capacity of many students.

Now, with a comprehensive vision, the education center has been shifted to a new location and continues its educational journey with new vigor from today.

On behalf of the Seeds Education Center and the students, we express our heartfelt gratitude to all the kind-hearted people who visited today's inauguration day and provided encouragement and motivation.

*On the journey of knowledge and love, may we all move forward towards new heights.*
